statements.query: MATCH (n:ProgrammingLanguage) WHERE NOT (n)--() WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
MATCH (n:PythonLibrary) WHERE NOT (n)--() WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

name: orphan sweep of shared ProgrammingLanguage and PythonLibrary catalog nodes
